quickref.status: Default; BBR v1.0 2011 → BBG; held in the Steam trailer (likely 2013 footage)
quickref.look: Squat olive-grey drum or turbine launcher in a dark-purple frame with a yellow notched muzzle disc, held two-handed at the belly and chest; about 0.45× Tillman wide. Not a chest hatch.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Arcing lob per the wiki; the official text says straight. A black navy rounded 'bullet with eyes' on a white smoke streak (Bullet Bill-like).
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes on contact (AoE 100/200) per the wiki; no impact image.

quickref.status: 25,000 Joules, level 3; BBR by Mar 2012 → BBG
quickref.look: The Big Shot drum in polished gold with an orange glowing muzzle disc.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Gold bullet-like missile on a dead-straight line, 1,200 u/s (wiki); no image.
quickref.impact_end_result: Smaller blast than the Big Shot but more direct damage (official text); no image.

quickref.status: 60,000 Joules, level 9; BBR by Mar 2012 → BBG; clip 1→3 in 2.6 (Dec 2013)
quickref.look: Long violet blaster with a yellow light slot and black-purple claw prongs around a glowing magenta-violet tip; about Tillman's height long.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A single slow orb; observed as a white-hot core in a hot-pink glow with pink blade swirls and pale-blue arcs.
quickref.impact_end_result: Large, dark, electrified blast; a sphere blinds anyone inside for 1–2 s (wiki). No image; the trailer's magenta sphere belongs to Astoria's segment.

quickref.status: 70 Gas; added BBR 1.3.1 (June 28, 2012) → BBG; clip 1→2 in 2.6
quickref.look: The Dark Matter body in white/silver with black stripes and white-black claw prongs around a cyan glowing tip.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Slow electric-blue orb in a spinning ring of blue segments, trailing lightning.
quickref.impact_end_result: A huge opaque white faceted dome ringed by cyan lightning (captioned image plus official 2014 thumbnail); blinding.

quickref.look: In-game hidden in an icy white-cyan glow; the concept is a red-tartan gun with a snowflake ornament and cyan hex gems.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Slow grey projectile, straight per the wiki (lobbed in the concept sketch).
quickref.impact_end_result: Freezes everyone in the blast for 2 s (no movement or camera), teammates included; the concept shows a jagged cyan ice-block encasement.

quickref.status: REMOVED; added BBG 2.2 (Aug 21, 2013), tweaked in 2.31 (Mar 2018), gone by May 2020 per the wiki
quickref.look: Stubby bell-mouthed launcher, white/grey with an orange 'PUSH' band, bomb-face decal and yellow tab, held at face height.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lobbed round black bomb with white winking eyes, red lips and a sparking fuse, trailing pink puffs.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes on each of 3 bounces, detonating on the third; cannot directly hit players; no explosion image.

quickref.status: 60/80 Gas; BBG 2.5 (Nov 27, 2013); becomes the BBH basic attack
quickref.look: Chunky purple robot mole with a silver spiral drill nose, glowing magenta eye and silver spikes, held at the hip.
quickref.impact_end_result: A straight-line chain of about six flame-like explosions (wiki); in BBH it burrows and explodes in a blast zone. No BBG image.

quickref.look: Two long pale olive/lime tubes with silver octagonal muzzle rims, one on each shoulder; not red/orange like Oliver's Bearzooka.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Rockets at 750 u/s, 3 ammo (wiki); a fan thumbnail shows small orange-red glowing shots.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explosive AoE 125/250 (wiki); a fan thumbnail shows a white-yellow starburst flash; no official image.

quickref.status: Default; BBR v1.0 2011 → BBG; still locked on in Dec 2013 (official), the wiki says no lock now
quickref.look: Four slim red firecracker rockets with orange cone tips and pink marks, upright on a black-grey striped back rack, two per side.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Vertical missiles: fuses lit, launched straight up, then spiral down onto the reticle spot.
quickref.impact_end_result: A flurry of orange sparks (wiki); no image. BBH successor: Firework Flurry.

quickref.status: 50,000 Joules, level 12; BBR by Mar 2012 → BBG
quickref.look: Long slim red rocket with yellow fins and a banded nose, worn diagonally over the right shoulder.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lock-on; launches straight up on a gold-white sparkle trail and dives nose-first on a yellow streak (trailer 30.0–30.4 s).
quickref.impact_end_result: A tall cone of hot-pink/magenta crystal shards plus a magenta shock-ring across the floor (captioned image, trailer, Steam screen 01).

quickref.status: 20 Gas, level 6; BBR original (as 'Peace Maker') → BBG
quickref.look: Fat rainbow-and-hippie-art missile reading 'MAKER', on the back, angled over the head.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lock-on or aimed; rises low and dives on a long jagged yellow-white flame trail; 7–8 s flight.
quickref.impact_end_result: Yellow-white ground flash under a translucent white-grey faceted mushroom cloud.

quickref.status: 15/20 Gas; added BBR 1.3.1 (June 28, 2012) → BBG; also BBF; in the Steam trailer
quickref.look: Chubby olive-drab bomb with a yellow-band nose, yellow-black radiation trefoil, X-eyed smiley badge and hazard-striped fins, worn nose-up on the back.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Climbs out of sight (about 10 s official), then streaks down on a long jagged yellow flame trail and homes on a locked target.
quickref.impact_end_result: A room-filling translucent yellow faceted blast that flings pieces (trailer, Steam screen 04); a white-grey faceted mushroom cloud in older footage.

quickref.look: Long red lance-rocket with a black-white checkerboard band, red fins and a yellow collar, angled over the shoulder; about 0.9× Tillman.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: No lock; slow lift, brief pause, then a fast dive to the exact aim point (floor or ceiling).

quickref.look: Thick green tube with an octagonal mouth and yellow shooting-star decals, worn on the back and aimed forward over the head.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lock-on firework that climbs for several seconds and drops back.
quickref.impact_end_result: Not an explosive: hovers just above the ground and sprays damaging sparks for 3.25 s (55–60 dps); does not gib; no image.

quickref.look: Four blue rockets with blue cone tips and grinning mint faces on the Fireworks back rack.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Rockets that rain down; no lock or homing.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes and freezes the target for 3 s (wiki); no image.

quickref.look: Two curved white robotic arms from the back arching overhead, each holding a big circular sawblade (about 0.6× Tillman across).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Slow (about 1 s) overhead swing that reaches behind and above, never straight ahead.
quickref.impact_end_result: Melee hit (25 dmg in 2013, 70 in the wiki infobox); gibs; no hit image.

quickref.look: Two hot-pink Huggable plush heads on the ends of the white backpack arms.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Same slow overhead and behind swing.
quickref.impact_end_result: Bonk hit, +10% speed; does not gib.

quickref.look: Two black spiked balls with grey grid pattern and white spikes on the white backpack arms.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Same slow overhead and behind swing.
quickref.impact_end_result: Mace hit, +15% health; no hit image.

soul_corrections.current_text: (1) salutes so hard the chest cannon fires;
soul_corrections.correction: (1) salutes so hard the Big Shot drum at his belly goes off [BBG News invention].
soul_corrections.evidence: The chest-hatch premise contradicts the observed Big Shot model (File:Big_Shot.jpg).

soul_corrections.current_text: Big Shot "(Chest Cannon)", Fireworks ("lock on feature"), Buzzard ("Double Buzzsaw Extension") [Canon] ([blog][blog])

soul_corrections.evidence: Trailer frames V/trailer/t_0057–t_0060 match the Phat Man model in File:Tillman_Phat_Man_copy.png and the trailer's Phat Man drop at 24–28 s; the thumbnail M/yt/rfAyqVJrli4_maxresdefault.jpg shows the same card.

soul_corrections.correction: The in-game BBG model (loadout screens) is pale white-pink with red-rimmed eye sockets, glowing white diamond eyes, a red diagonal sash, black limbs with red stripes and treaded wheels [Observed].

soul_corrections.current_text: cylindrical teal backpack on a diagonal teal chest strap [Observed]
soul_corrections.correction: Teal pack and teal strap appear in the 2D art and the BBH model [Observed]; the in-game BBG model has a red sash and a black-and-grey striped back rack that carries the secondaries (four Fireworks rockets by default) [Observed].
soul_corrections.evidence: 2D: File:Demo-darkmatter.png, File:Demolition.png. BBG 3D: File:Fireworks.jpg, File:Demo_(Wide).png, File:DemoDefault.jpg. BBH: YouTube ihkXJS4Oatk thumbnail.

soul_corrections.correction: Keep as official wording (the wiki also quotes it as the BBG class description [Game text via wiki]), but note that the Reverse Fountain is a non-explosive spark spray [Fan-wiki] and the melees are saws, plush heads and maces [Observed]; the BBR source page was not re-verified today.
soul_corrections.evidence: https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Reverse_Fountain (Type 'Secondary - DPS', 'not an explosive'); melee images File:Buzzards.jpg, File:DoubleHug.jpg, File:GoodMorning.jpg.

soul_corrections.current_text: cylindrical teal backpack on a diagonal teal chest strap, small armour cracks at top right of head and bottom left of body
soul_corrections.correction: For BBG-era prompts: red diagonal sash; black-and-grey striped back rack holding four upright red firecracker rockets; a two-handed purple-and-grey drum launcher with a yellow muzzle at the belly. Keep teal only for 2D-art or BBH versions.

soul_corrections.current_text: gleefully launches fireworks as explosions rattle him
soul_corrections.correction: fires four red firecracker rockets straight up off his back rack that rain down in orange sparks.
soul_corrections.evidence: Official text 'vertical missiles' [Game text via wiki]; wiki usage 'landing a second or two later in a spiralling cascade… orange sparks'; rack look from File:Fireworks.jpg.

soul_corrections.current_text: **Weapons:** Big Shot "(Chest Cannon)", Fireworks ("lock on feature"), Buzzard ("Double Buzzsaw Extension") [Canon] ([blog][blog]), still BBG defaults [Fan-wiki]; Blast-O-Mole, "Tillman's pet mole" [Game text via wiki] ([mole][wmole]); BBH "Firework Flurry" [Canon] ([characters][chars]).
soul_corrections.correction: Point to the full 18-item BBG arsenal: primaries Big Shot, Gold Member, Dark Matter, Light Matter, S'no Matter, Bouncing Betty (removed; still live at 2.31 in Mar 2018, gone by May 2020 per the wiki), Blast-O-Mole and Twin Bearzookas; secondaries Fireworks, Happy Hour, Piece Maker, Phat Man, RPL, Reverse Fountain and Let It Cold; melees Buzzard, Double Hug and Good Morning.
